requirements.general: STPM Pass with a minimum Grade C in any two (2) subjects Pass in Mathematics and English at the SPM level A-Level Pass with a minimum Grade D in any two (2) subjects Pass in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent UEC Pass with a minimum Grade B in five (5) subjects Pass in Mathematics and English STAM Pass with a minimum Grade Jayyid (good) Pass in Mathematics and English at SPM level Foundation / Matriculation Pass with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 Diploma / Advanced Diploma (Level 4/5, MQF) Pass with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 or its equivalent Additional Notes The requirement to pass Mathematics at the SPM level can be waived if the qualifications contain Mathematics with an equivalent or higher achievement. Malaysian students who used English as the medium of instruction in their previous studies or have at least Band 2 in MUET or equivalent are exempted from the English requirement. Candidates without a pass in Mathematics and/or English at SPM level or equivalent may be admitted but are required to attend special enhancement courses, which are equivalent to SPM. English Language Requirements (for International Students) MUET: Minimum score of 4.0 IELTS: Minimum score of 5.5 TOEFL: Ess OL: 8 iBT: 46 Pearson: Minimum score of 51 Linguaskill: Minimum score of 160 OET: Minimum score of 200 Note: International students from educational systems where English is the main medium of instruction are exempted from this requirement. International students who do not meet the English language requirements may enroll in the Intensive English Programme at Nilai University, which builds their skills and prepares them for the IELTS examination.
